question: Estimate the adoption of co-working spaces in Tier 2 cities by 2028.
idealClarificationQuestions: Active members at co-working operators (WeWork, Smartworks, 91springboard, Awfis, IndiQube) in Tier 2 cities? Yes.
Tier 2 = ~100 cities? Yes — focus on cities like Indore, Jaipur, Coimbatore, Kochi, Vizag, Lucknow.
Total seat capacity used or members? Members (people).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bottom-up: Tier 2 white-collar workforce → flex-space appetite → operator capacity build-out.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, employed in firms small enough to use coworking (vs own office): ~20% = 6M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Drivers to 2028: GCC (Global Capability Centers) expansion to Tier 2 (Coimbatore, Kochi), startup ecosystem maturation.
